beat_block_hammer.instruction: Grab the grippy handle hammer using the right arm then pound block
Take the hammer with two-tone handle and hammer the block
Lift the silver curved hammer head and hit the block.
Lift the silver curved hammer head with the left arm then strike block
Take the yellow and black hammer grip and strike the block

pick_dual_bottles.instruction: Catch the dark drink bottle with logo in one arm, the bottle with white printed label in the other.
Hold the brown bottle with red label in one hand and the handheld green bottle in another.
Reach for the Coca-Cola bottle, then grab the smooth green bottle.
Grasp the bottle with ridges on bottom and the bottle with narrow top with both arms.
Hold the Coca-Cola bottle and the medium green bottle separately.

stamp_seal.instruction: Grab the yellow seal and press Olive
Hold the stamp with red top and press Lime
Take the palm-sized stamping seal and stamp it on Tan.
With the left arm, secure the seal with vertical textured grip and mark Lime.
Press the stamp with red top firmly onto Red
